evals.prompt: A repo whose tests use Docker compose stacks. Following only the fleet skill, (1) write the exact dispatch prompt for issue #42 "Add retry", worktree /w/repo-issue-42, base feat/retries, size s, files internal/retry.go; (2) list exactly what reconcile does to tear down issue #42's worktree and any containers/volumes it started after its PR merges.
evals.expected_output: The dispatch prompt names no Docker or COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME line. Reconcile tears down only via `tp remove <branch> --merged` and says the repo's treepad remove hook owns cleanup of anything the worktree started; fleet names no technology.

evals.prompt: Follow dispatch.md for label `demo` with three ready, non-tiny tickets: #10, #11 and #12 all name internal/app.go and the golden directory testdata/golden/. Say how each worktree is based, what runs in parallel, each prompt's Base, and what the final report tells the user about merging.
evals.expected_output: No chains: all three worktrees are created up front from origin/feat/demo and run in parallel, and every prompt has Base: feat/demo. There is no merge simulation or rebase step. The report lists PRs in issue order, tells the user to merge in that order, and says a PR GitHub shows as conflicting needs the feat/demo tip merged into its branch by hand.
